inputs.name: points[*].positions

inputs.description: Target position of gripper_joint_1 in radians

inputs.name: max_effort

facts.text: KeyboardController creates a JointTrajectory publisher on /arm_controller/joint_trajectory.
KeyboardController creates a GripperCommand action client on /gripper_controller/gripper_cmd.
KeyboardController subscribes to /joint_states with sensor_msgs/JointState.
KeyboardController uses the five arm joint names joint1 through joint5.
The teleop hardcodes demo gripper travel constants gripper_max 1.1 and gripper_min 0.0.
The teleop hardcodes demo max_effort 10.0 for the gripper command.
send_arm_command publishes a one-point JointTrajectory and does not wait for controller execution.
send_gripper_command sends a GripperCommand goal and waits only for the send future, not the terminal result.
The bringup executor imports control_msgs.action.FollowJointTrajectory.
The bringup executor defaults action_topic to /arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory.
The bringup executor's goal_response_callback logs a rejected goal and returns without requesting a result.
shutdown_node requests goal cancellation only when a goal handle exists, does not await it, then destroys the node and exits.
The omx_f controller manager configures arm_controller as a JointTrajectoryController and gripper_controller as a GripperActionController.
The arm_controller declares joint1 through joint5 and the gripper_controller declares gripper_joint_1.
The omx_f arm xacro gives each of joint1 through joint5 the same revolute limit block: velocity 4.8, effort 1000, lower -pi*2.0 and upper pi*2.0.
gripper_joint_1 is revolute and its model limit block gives velocity 4.8, effort 1000, lower -pi*2.0 and upper pi*2.0.
The omx_f ros2_control description starts with disable_torque_at_init=true.
The omx_f ros2_control description names the relative torque service dynamixel_hardware_interface/set_dxl_torque.
QNode::init creates a std_srvs::srv::SetBool client named dynamixel_hardware_interface/set_dxl_torque.
QNode::sendTorqueSrv sets request->data from its checked argument and calls async_send_request, but logs success and returns true without waiting for or checking the service response.
QNode::stopMotion sets a GUI flag and calls MoveGroupInterface::stop locally in the GUI process.
resetStopRequest only clears the GUI's stop_requested_ flag.

measures.description: Joint positions reported by one /joint_states sample in the publisher's order
measures.name: joint_positions

measures.description: Read one sensor_msgs/JointState sample from /joint_states; the arrays are reported in the publisher's order and this does not prove that every arm joint is present
measures.name: read_joint_state

operator_required.name: command_gripper
operator_required.reason: the model effort limit is 1000 (omx_f_arm.urdf.xacro:212); its mapping to the installed GripperCommand controller effort and safe payload needs an operator envelope; teleop max_effort=10.0 is only a demo constant

operator_required.name: command_gripper
operator_required.reason: the xacro models gripper_joint_1 at -2*pi..2*pi radians (omx_f_arm.urdf.xacro:207-212), but the operator must supply the narrower installed gripper travel envelope; teleop 0.0-1.1 is only a demo constant
